items.title: Team Gambia Coalition Pledges New Constitution Within 18 Months if Elected
items.summary: By Seedy Jobe Team Gambia Grand Coalition 2026 has outlined an ambitious political and governance agenda ahead of the 2026-27 election cycle, pledging to introduce a new constitution within 18 months if elected and to select its presidential candidate through nationwide consul...
